id: title:Gilbert09:add bugsnag error grain and performance tables

review.posthog_relevance: Adds warehouse ingestion support for BugSnag error-grain and span-group performance endpoints, including pagination and status handling.
review.reason: This chunk demonstrates a substantive, bounded capability improvement. P1.F2.H1 and P1.F2.H5 add offset-based pagination and bounded fan-out, preventing unbounded requests and enabling ingestion of performance data. P1.F2.H7 and P1.F2.H8 configure the ingestion to treat 404s as missing data and use offset pagination, which is required for the new endpoints. P1.F5.H1 documents the 3
review.uncertainty: The tier relies on the assumption that the configuration and pagination helpers are sufficient for the tier; the actual ingestion implementation and its validation are not shown, so the tier is assigned based on the configuration and pagination support rather than the complete ingestion and its validation.

observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by documentation and implementation changes. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds 4 new fields to the coverage status list and checks the error-grain trend and pivot endpoints.
observations.posthog_connection: Updates the documentation of supported BugSnag API fields; does not change ingestion or query behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds imports for offset pagination and URL parsing, and a helper to construct the next page URL for offset-based pagination.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds the capability to paginate BugSnag performance endpoints, which do not use the Link header.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper to construct the next page URL for offset-based pagination, and a helper to take a capped subset of an iterator, and several parent builders for error, pivot, and span-group fan-out.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds bounded fan-out and offset pagination, preventing unbounded requests and allowing ingestion of performance and error-grain data.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the new error-grain and span-group endpoints, only the configuration and the removal of the release-stage and pivot-specific parent-building logic. The tier cannot be established without seeing the actual fan-out and ingestion implementation.

observations.behavior: Removes release-stage and pivot-specific parent-building, replaces with a factory lookup.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces branching and couples the parent-building to a registry, allowing the warehouse ingestion to support the new error and span-group scopes without duplicating release-stage or pivot-specific request handling. This supports the configuration added in P1.F4.

observations.behavior: Adds missing_data_statuses and paginate_by_offset parameters to page-fetching, supporting the new error and span-group endpoints.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the warehouse ingestion to treat 404s and other statuses as missing data rather than failures, and to use offset-based pagination for endpoints that do not support cursor-based pagination. This is required for the span-group and error-grain endpoints, which use offset pagination and return 404s for missing errors.

observations.behavior: Adds missing_data_statuses and paginate_by_offset parameters to page-fetching, supporting the new error and span-group endpoints.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the warehouse ingestion to treat 404s and other statuses as missing data rather than failures, and to use offset-based pagination for endpoints that do not support cursor-based pagination. This is required for the span-group and error-grain endpoints, which use offset pagination and return 404s for missing errors.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment requested.

observations.behavior: Adds documentation for three new Bugsnag warehouse ingestion endpoints: error_trend, error_pivot_values, span_group_spans.
observations.posthog_connection: These endpoints are exposed to PostHog warehouse ingestion, allowing customers to import error and span-group data into PostHog warehouse. Documentation clarifies their behavior and performance characteristics.

observations.behavior: Adds documentation for the span_group_spans endpoint, noting it is a sample rather than full history.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies that span_group_spans returns a sample of recent spans, not full history, helping warehouse consumers understand the data completeness.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test helper function _collect_via_responses to support pagination tests without mocking the full HTTP layer.
observations.posthog_connection: Supports testing of pagination and offset handling for warehouse ingestion, which is critical for reliability and correctness of large-scale data imports.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains only test additions and assertions. No implementation, configuration, or production behavior is shown. No score can be assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test class and several test assertions, including checks for error-grain endpoint capping and parent ID propagation.
observations.posthog_connection: These assertions could help maintainers verify that the warehouse ingestion for BugSnag error and span-group data respects request caps and correctly propagates parent IDs, but without the corresponding implementation, no production benefit is demonstrated.
